domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India split could be retrieved: the web_search tool returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on both queries, so no domestic-supply record was read. What is on record is only the customs address of the Indian plant ("9P, 11P, 139P, AT- DITASAN , P.O. - JAGUDAN", Mehsana district, Gujarat) and the fact that the entity both imports from Ammann group plants (AMMANN SCHWEIZ AG 957 shipments, AMMANN ASPHALT GMBH 616, AMMANN CZECH REPUBLIC S.R.O. 608) and re-exports — which implies local assembly/manufacture but is not itself a domestic sales record. Domestic supply therefore: declared, not confirmed.
note: Legal entity verified as AMMANN INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (the 'Ammann Apollo India' name is the legacy/former style; the slug /ammann-apollo-india-private-limited on ImportKey returns an empty record set — 'Loading...' with no shipment rows — while /ammann-india-private-limited returns 9718 records). Export activity is factually confirmed with dated customs entries, destination, HS code and B/L numbers, so this is not a website claim. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared_hs 847149 (ADP/data-processing machines) does not match the actual trade: observed HS codes are 90251990 (temperature sensors), 40081110 (rubber profiles), 84834000 (gears/transmission), 85371090 (control panels), 39269099 (plastic articles) — the company is an asphalt/concrete mixing plant and machinery manufacturer (Ammann group, Swiss parent), not an IT/electronics trader. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base, the code should be corrected to the actual machinery/spare-parts HS range (8474/8483/9025), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry field 'IT и электроника' is likewise incorrect.
